description: This file contains unit tests for the AssistantLaunch functionality in the Android app, verifying intent parsing logic for different assistant launch scenarios.

classes.name: AssistantLaunchTest
classes.description: A test class using Robolectric to verify intent parsing for assistant launch in the app.

methods.name: parsesAssistGestureIntent
methods.description: Tests parsing of assist gesture intent, expecting source 'assist', no prompt, and autoSend false.

methods.name: parsesAppActionPrompt
methods.description: Tests parsing of app action intent with prompt 'summarize my unread texts' and autoSend true.

methods.name: ignoresUnrelatedIntents
methods.description: Verifies that unrelated intent actions return null, indicating no parsing.
